requirements.description: User prefers the unit to be near parks. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

User prefers energy class D or better, so classes A1 through D are included. Area (115 sqm), capacity (15 people), location (Turin) and proximity to parks are not energy requirements and are outside this agent's scope.

The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area. The 15-person capacity is not converted into a surface threshold because no verified gross-area threshold from the RegulatoryAgent is available. The energy class, the future play-space use, and the proximity to parks are outside the reference columns or describe future use or location, so they are not filtered here.
